name: UNCLI
description: AI CLIs if you're not a CLI guy.
//: The root scripts are the one command surface for every stack: VS Code tasks, CI and Claude all call
npm run dev | build | check | test | release. Add each once the app exists, e.g. for Go + Wails + Svelte:
check:   cd app && go vet ./... && npm --prefix frontend run check
test:    cd app && go test ./... && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
release: pwsh scripts/build.ps1 (writes installers and zips to dist/)
CI skips any that are missing. For several JS packages, add "workspaces": ["app/frontend", ...].
